reviews.reviewbody: It's weird how persons compiling this kind of material doesn't see them selves as 'obsessed' in some manner. This is the stupidest crap since 'Q'. Imagine how far off the rails you need be to make this your life. Satanic pedo rings running world gov.? WTF? As if the terms don't end for the politicians. And to think all that crap could be held under wraps. It takes an insane person to think all that idiotic crap is actually going on. I am more concerned about that person ever having any authority or power. Seek professional help.

In the first place, being mean and surly from the get-go is rude - especially in view of the fact that of the 7536 persons which have visited this compilation of old-and-forgotten news reports (in the last thirteen mos.), 94 other persons thought more highly of it all-in-all and complemented my efforts in uploading this "stupid crap" by starring the post - one other person even going so far as to favourite the "idiotic crap" posted here.

You wrote "crap" thrice in your rhetorical poop on me: I'd like you to know that I rarely-if-ever think of this documentation, as I am quite active in other research at the moment, which is why I uploaded what I did, here... for those that may of may not have or take interest in this sad matter. 

So, please... just imagine how the world would be if we were all like you [ ] and buried what was once newsworthy... making it so that others hadst naught any opportunity to review the "crap" for themselves, eh! and thereby, maybe, formulate their own opinions wherewith of informed consent to do so as exists in their hearts even as well as their minds. 

To anyone reading this response: Why would anyone want to waste a moment of life being mean and saying rude things, and in an uncomplimentary manner attempt to deceive others with malicious intent. 

I know that any response is the wrong response - and an invitation to a "shit-fight"... but something had to be said in defence of my postings. 

I assure you all that I am in no way obsessed with this old-and-forgotten news, and in no way have any interest in further pursuing this matter.

o/
